verdicts.evidence: Probed rather than argued, as instructed: the pack is byte-identical for every mission name tried ("demo-mission", "", "a", a 200-char name, a non-ASCII name). The reason is arithmetic - every read of the digest is bounded by 32: the assignments touch b[12] and b[16], and the five slices are [0,8) [8,12) [12,16) [16,20) [20,32). The extra 32 hex digits the mutant leaves in the array are never read. SENSITIVITY: make one read unbounded - `s.slice(20)` instead of `s.slice(20, 32)` - and the mutant emits a 44-character tail, breaking the RFC-4122 shape that test/oscal-schema.js's negative control asserts and that spec section 5 pins.
